title: World Rugby FPRC Decision Dan Sheehan incl PS
text:
FOUL PLAY REVIEW COMMITTEE
DECISION
PARTICULARS OF OFFENCE
Player’s surname Sheehan Player’s Dan
forename(s)
Player’s Union British & Irish Lions (“BIL”)
Match BIL v Australia
Competition BIL Tour 2025 Match Date 2 August 2025
SELECT: Red card ☐ Citing ☒
Offence 9.20 Dangerous play in a ruck or maul.
(a)A player must not charge into a ruck or
maul
Finding of Committee Foul Play not admitted.
Foul play determined? Foul play determined.
Red card upheld? Citing upheld.
Summary of Sanction Four (4) week suspension reduced to (3) weeks upon successful complete of the coaching
intervention programme.
Matches/tournaments Four (4) matches for Leinster:
included in sanction
Match 1 13 September 2025, Leinster vs Cardiff [pre-season]
Match 2 26 September 2025, Leinster vs Stormers [URC]
Match 3 11 October 2025, Leinster vs Sharks [URC]
Match 4 18 October 2025, Leinster vs Munster [URC]
The Player will be free to play in Match 4 if he completes the coaching intervention programme
REASONS FOR DECISION
Evidence
1. The FPRC received and considered the following material:
a. Citing Commissioner’s Report;
b. victim player’s (AUS#10) statement;
c. Australia team doctor’s report that AUS#10 failed the HIA (i.e. suffered a concussion);
d. written submission on behalf of the Player;
e. testimonial from Chief Operating Officer of Leinster Rugby.
Disciplinary Decision Foul Play Review Committee Page 1 of 2

2. The Player did not accept that he committed an act of foul play1 and argued:
a. he made contact with the upper body and shoulder AUS#10, not AUS#10’s head;
b. he made an attempt to bind with both arms but there was no space for his right arm;
c. the contact which caused the head injury to AUS#10 was made by BIL#19’s knee, subsequent to the Player’s
contact with AUS#10.
Decision
3. The Red Card threshold was met. The FPRC upheld the Citing applying the Head Contact Process (2023):
a. head contact – Yes. The Player’s right upper arm and/or elbow made contact with the right side of AUS 10’s
head, which was consistent with video footage (01:27) and AUS#10’s statement on a heavy blow to the right
side of his head. Contact by BIL#19’s knee was to the top of AUS#10’s head (00:44);
b. foul play – Yes. The Player’s actions were reckless. AUS#10 had already set in position at the ruck prior to the
Player’s approach. The Player had time and clear line of sight. The Player did not bind with his right arm.2 He
approached at pace from distance; launched off his right foot and dropped his right shoulder with his upper
arm and/or elbow making contact with AUS#10’s head;
c. degree of danger – High. The Player approached from a distance, at speed and did not slow down. He was
dynamic;
d. mitigation – None. The Player had time and clear line of sight. The Player did not have control – he
accelerated from a distance; he did not slow down and he lost his feet. AUS#10 braced for contact but there
was no significant drop or movement.
Sanction
4. The FPRC applied the mandatory mid-range entry point of 6 weeks due to the head contact. There was no basis
for moving to top end.
5. As the Player denied foul play, the FPRC did not agree to full 50% mitigation. Based on the Player’s clean record
and experience the FPRC applied a reduction of 2 weeks (reducing sanction to 4 weeks).
6. The Player applied for and is eligible for the coaching intervention programme, which the FPRC approves.
Foul Play Review Mike Mika (NZ)
Committee Members
Valeriu Toma (ROM)
Signature Date 3 August 2025
Chair
Wang Shao-Ing
1 Paragraph 14 of Written Submissions - The Player does not accept that he committed an act of foul play or that any action on his part merited
a red card.
2 Law 15.7 - A player must bind onto a team-mate or an opposition player. The bind must precede or be simultaneous with contact with any
other part of the body.
Disciplinary Decision Foul Play Review Committee Page 2 of 2

Dan Sheehan (BIL) FPRC Decision
Postscript: (22 August 2025)
On 7 August 2025, the Player’s counsel informed the FPRC that a Leinster's URC fixture on
4 October 2025 against the Bulls had been omitted (in error) from the fixtures provided to
the FPRC at the time of its decision. The FPRC considered the delayed request and agreed
to include the fixture in the suspension. Consequently, the Player is suspended from the
following:
Four (4) matches for Leinster:
Match 1 -13 September 2025, Leinster vs Cardi4 [pre-season]
Match 2 - 26 September 2025, Leinster vs Stormers [URC]
Match 3 - 4 October 2025, Leinster vs Bulls [URC]
Match 4 - 11 October 2025, Leinster vs Sharks [URC]
The Player will be free to play in Match 4 if he completes the coaching intervention
programme.
